name: Cross Rib Beef Roast
notes: Cross rib roasts are often relegated to crock pot or slow roasting. This method yields a tender and yummy main dish for Sunday dinner!

items: Hot water for desired amount of gravy
1 tsp beef bouillon for each cup of hot water
½ cup flour or ¼ cup corn starch

steps.title: Brush the roast
steps.body: Brush **3-4 lb roast** with **6 Tbsp balsamic vinegar**.

steps.title: Rub the roast
steps.body: Mix and rub on roast: **6 Tbsp minced garlic**, **6 tsp thyme**, **3 tsp rosemary**, **3 Tbsp salt**, **3 Tbsp pepper** and **3 Tbsp olive oil**.

steps.title: Roast
steps.body: Bake at 450°F for 15 minutes, fat side up.

steps.title: Finish roasting
steps.body: Then bake at 350°F until internal temp is 125–140°F (depending on your preference, about 1-2 hours).

steps.title: Rest
steps.body: Remove roast from oven, and cover with foil for at least 10 minutes before carving.

steps.title: Start the gravy
steps.body: Go ahead and use some of the rub remnants in the dripping for a gourmet gravy! Brown drippings from roasting pan, then add hot water for desired amount of gravy and **1 tsp beef bouillon** for each cup of hot water. Bring to a boil.

steps.title: Whisk the flour
steps.body: In the meantime, whisk together **1 cup water** and **½ cup flour or ¼ cup corn starch**.

steps.title: Thicken the gravy
steps.body: While whisking, slowly pour this mixture into the boiling water and drippings, until gravy reaches desired thickness. Season to taste with salt and pepper.
